prompt.en: Who became Canada's first Prime Minister in 1867?
prompt.fr: Qui est devenu le premier premier ministre du Canada en 1867?

explanation.en: The first person to hold the office, in 1867, was Sir John Alexander Macdonald, who had also been one of the Fathers of Confederation. Parliament marks his birthday, January 11, as Sir John A. Macdonald Day.
explanation.fr: La première personne à occuper ce poste, en 1867, a été sir John Alexander Macdonald, qui comptait aussi parmi les Pères de la Confédération. Le Parlement souligne son anniversaire, le 11 janvier, comme la Journée sir John A. Macdonald.

source.quote: In 1867, Sir John Alexander Macdonald, a Father of Confederation, became Canada’s first Prime Minister.

verification.evidence: In 1867, Sir John Alexander Macdonald, a Father of Confederation, became Canada’s first Prime Minister. Born in Scotland on January 11, 1815, he came to Upper Canada as a child. … Parliament has recognized January 11 as Sir John A. Macdonald Day. His portrait is on the $10 bill.
